title: Data source candidate
description: One proposed free data source for the screener, written by the research-sources skill. Purely descriptive/evaluative — never implemented from here.

name.description: Short human name, e.g. 'FRED 30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate'

slug.description: Filename slug, matches research/candidates/<slug>.json and the memo

url.description: Canonical docs/landing page for the dataset or API

api_endpoint.description: The actual data endpoint, if different from url

coverage.description: Geographic scope: national / state / a named metro or county list / NYC-specific

granularity.description: national | state | county | tract | zcta | msa | point, etc.

history.description: How far back data goes, and whether that's enough for backtest.py to mean anything

license.description: Cost, login/registration requirement, ToS restrictions on commercial/product use

fits_existing_source_kind.description: Which app.sources.base.Source.kind this would use, per backend/CLAUDE.md; 'none' flags an architecture gap

correlation.description: Output of app/research/evaluate_series.py against FHFA tract HPI growth and Zillow ZORI, if that tool exists yet; otherwise a note that it wasn't run and why

existing_overlap.description: What's already covered in backend/sources.yaml / app/sources/ that this would duplicate, if anything
